title: Exit portal missing next_scene property, blocking level progression
explanation: At frame 4023, the player touches Portal2D at the end of Map3, but Portal2D.gd:L56 aborts transition because next_scene is null, emitting missing_expected_object. In Map3_SkyCastle.tscn:L40, Portal2D is instanced without a next_scene assignment, violating the progression contract and soft-locking completion.
